nodes.name: ReloadBar.cs
nodes.summary: In-world progress bar for ranged weapon reloading. Subscribes to the Reloader's active weapon instance data via ReactiveUnity OnChange, shows/scales a child SpriteRenderer to the reload progress each frame while IsReloading is true.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Reactive<T>.OnChange callbacks stored as Action unsubscribe closures, an Assert.IsNotNull inspector check, and a coroutine for per-frame bar scaling.

nodes.name: Reloader.cs
nodes.summary: Drives reload and fire-cooldown timers for the player's currently equipped ranged weapon. In FixedUpdate it advances ReloadElapsed/CoolDownElapsed on the weapon's InstanceData and flips IsReloading/IsCoolingDown Reactive flags when complete, refilling the clip.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity Reactive<T> fields for the active weapon and its instance data; timer logic lives in FixedUpdate using Time.fixedDeltaTime.

nodes.name: SteeringForces.cs
nodes.summary: Static library of steering behaviors for enemy/bird AI: Seek, a wander force with a projected ring, obstacle avoidance via CircleCast, a Reynolds-style boid force (separation/alignment/cohesion over nearest IFlockMate neighbors), and a collision-mask helper that derives interaction layers from the rigidbody and layer matrix.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure static helpers returning Vector2 forces so callers sum them into their own movement; generic method over IFlockMate for boid behavior.

nodes.name: FishBarTrigger.cs
nodes.summary: A trigger zone on the fishing minigame bar. Reports when the rising cursor passes it (OnTriggerExit2D sends PassedFishBarTrigger up the hierarchy), toggles a fulfilled/unfulfilled sprite, and optionally oscillates up and down within clamped bounds at a FishingRound-configured speed.
nodes.languageNotes: SendMessageUpwards for minigame communication; oscillation driven in FixedUpdate by translating the trigger transform between local bounds.

nodes.name: FishType.cs
nodes.summary: Config ScriptableBehaviour-style component describing a catchable fish: which scenes it can be caught in, the Inventory.Item it grants, spawnable seasons/day periods, and a list of FishingRound minigame difficulty configs (speed, trigger count/spacing, stacking modifier, oscillation).

nodes.name: FishingGame.cs
nodes.summary: The fishing minigame. Picks a valid FishType for the current scene/season/period, runs one or more rounds where a rising cursor passes trigger bars the player must time with the use key, handles hit/miss detection via Overlap, and on win awards the fish item + capture-log entry while on fail shakes and launches the cursor.
nodes.languageNotes: Static singleton Instance; static readonly TRIGGER_MAPPING_* constants map normalized positions (y=mx+b) to the bar; coroutine-driven rounds; DOTween DOShakePosition for the fail shake; Logger for round/fish diagnostics.

nodes.name: Axe.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject axe item. Sets the player to the Axing state and triggers OnUseAxe on world objects that implement IUseableWithAxe (trees/stumps), playing a chop sound; costs energy.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item ScriptableObject implementing UseItemInput.IUsableOnWorldObject / IUsableWithoutTarget / IEnergyDepleting; nested interface IUseableWithAxe for targets.

nodes.name: Binoculars.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject binoculars item that switches the player into the Birding state and starts the birding minigame via BirdingGame.Instance.Play(this), passing beam rotation/acceleration and charge/cursor timing settings; costs energy.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item ScriptableObject; exposes tuning floats for the birding cursor beam, consumed by BirdingGame.

nodes.name: Bow.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject bow ranged weapon. On use, hands off to BowChargeController.StartCharge when a projectile spawn point exists (charged shots with crit window), otherwise fires immediately via TryFire; exposes charge time, min-speed multiplier, and crit-shot charge range.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends RangedWeaponItem (fire rate/clip/reload); interfaces with BowChargeController attached to the projectile spawn center GameObject.

nodes.name: DryLog.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject dry-log item placed on world objects: loads into a LarchStump or adds to a WoodRack, consuming the active inventory item and playing a placement sound on success.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing UseItemInput.IUsableOnWorldObject with type-check pattern-matching against LarchStump/WoodRack.

nodes.name: Firewood.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject firewood item that adds fuel to a WoodStove or Campfire, consuming the active inventory item and playing a placement sound on success.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing UseItemInput.IUsableOnWorldObject; pattern-matches WoodStove/Campfire and calls AddFirewood().

nodes.name: Fly Agaric 1.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject fly-agaric mushroom variant (fly agaric 1). Edible food: removing the active item and calling Diet.EatFood against the player's energy manager to recover protein/carbs/nutrients.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; identical to the other Fly Agaric variants apart from the asset class name.

nodes.name: Fly Agaric 2.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject fly-agaric mushroom variant (fly agaric 2). Edible food: removes the active item and feeds it to the player's energy manager via Diet.EatFood for protein/carbs/nutrients.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; near-duplicate of the other Fly Agaric variants.

nodes.name: Fly Agaric.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject fly-agaric mushroom item. Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients to the player via Diet.EatFood.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; base variant of the near-duplicate Fly Agaric 1/2 scripts.

nodes.name: Hammer.cs
nodes.summary: Empty ScriptableObject hammer item marker used for gifting/crafting progression; carries no behavior beyond being an Inventory.Item.

nodes.name: Kokanee.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject kokanee salmon item. Both a gift (UseOnWorldObject hands it to IGiftReceiving targets like NPCs via TryGiveGift) and an edible food (Diet.EatFood for protein/carbs/nutrients).
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood plus both IUsableWithoutTarget and IUsableOnWorldObject for eat-or-gift dual use.

nodes.name: Larch Bolete 2.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject larch bolete mushroom variant (bolete 2). Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients via Diet.EatFood; zero energy cost.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; near-duplicate of the other Larch Bolete variants.

nodes.name: Larch Bolete 3.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject larch bolete mushroom variant (bolete 3). Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients via Diet.EatFood; zero energy cost.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; near-duplicate of the other Larch Bolete variants.

nodes.name: Larch Bolete.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject larch bolete mushroom item. Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients via Diet.EatFood; zero energy cost.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood and IUsableWithoutTarget; base variant of the near-duplicate Larch Bolete 2/3 scripts.

nodes.name: LooseItem.cs
nodes.summary: World-space dropped item holding an Inventory.ItemStack and an animator; becomes magnetically attractable to the player once its animation reaches the Idle state (so it can't be grabbed mid-drop).
nodes.languageNotes: MonoBehaviour with [RequireComponent(typeof(Animator))]; polls the current animator state name in Update to gate IsMagnetic.

nodes.name: RainbowTrout.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject rainbow trout item. Both a gift (UseOnWorldObject hands it to IGiftReceiving targets via TryGiveGift) and an edible food (Diet.EatFood for protein/carbs/nutrients); zero energy cost.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing Diet.IFood plus both IUsableWithoutTarget and IUsableOnWorldObject for eat-or-gift dual use.

nodes.name: Rod.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject fishing rod item used on tilemaps: casting on the Water tilemap starts fishing (FishingGame.CastForFish) while already fishing reels the line in, toggling the player between Fishing and Idle states; costs energy.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing UseItemInput.IUsableOnTileMap; drives FishingGame.Instance lifecycle based on the cursor tilemap layer name.

nodes.name: Sling.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject sling ranged weapon that fires instantly on use via RangedWeaponItem.TryFire, with a per-shot energy cost.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends RangedWeaponItem; the smallest weapon script — a one-line UseWithoutTarget that forwards to TryFire.

nodes.name: SpawnLooseItemsOnDestroy.cs
nodes.summary: Spawns configured loose items from a collider when the object is disabled, unless disabled by a scene unload (checks gameObject.scene.isLoaded); items are launched with velocity and drag. Named OnDestroy but hooks OnDisable to exclude scene-exit destruction.
nodes.languageNotes: MonoBehaviour; wraps SpawnItems.SpawnItemsFromCollider and guards against scene unload so loot doesn't spawn during saves.

nodes.name: WetLog.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject wet-log item. Trying to burn it on a WoodStove/Campfire posts a 'too wet to burn' dialogue message, while placing it on a WoodRack dries it (TryAddWetLog), consuming the active item.
nodes.languageNotes: Inventory.Item implementing UseItemInput.IUsableOnWorldObject; dialogue feedback via PlayerDialogue.Instance.PostMessage.

nodes.name: ReloadBar
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that visually mirrors the active ranged weapon's reload state by scaling a child progress-bar SpriteRenderer; subscribes/unsubscribes to ReactiveUnity change events for the active weapon and its IsReloading flag.

nodes.name: Reloader
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour holding the active RangedWeaponItem and its InstanceData as Reactive properties; in FixedUpdate it advances reload and cooldown timers, refills the clip and clears the flags when done. CoolDownTime derives from the weapon's shots-per-second.

nodes.name: IFlockMate
nodes.summary: Interface exposing a flock neighbor's Position and Velocity so generic boid behavior can run against any moving entity (enemies, birds).

nodes.name: SteeringForces
nodes.summary: Static steering math library: Seek, wander ring, CircleCast-based avoidance, boid separation/alignment/cohesion, and a LayerMask builder from the rigidbody's ignore matrix.

nodes.name: FishBarTrigger
nodes.summary: Minigame trigger bar: swaps between fulfilled/unfulfilled sprites, reports when the cursor passes it, and optionally oscillates vertically within clamped play-area bounds for harder rounds.

nodes.name: FishType
nodes.summary: Component describing a catchable species: scene whitelist, granted Inventory.Item, spawnable seasons/day periods, and its list of FishingRound minigame difficulty configs.

nodes.name: FishingRound
nodes.summary: Serializable per-round minigame config: game speed, trigger count/spacing, stacked-trigger modifier (none/doubles/mega), and optional trigger oscillation speed/length.

nodes.name: FishingGame
nodes.summary: Singleton minigame orchestrator: picks a valid fish, runs timed rounds with a rising cursor passing trigger bars, handles the use-key hit/miss check, and resolves win (reward + capture log) or fail (shake, blink, cursor launch).

nodes.name: Axe
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject axe tool; sets the Axing player state and invokes OnUseAxe on IUseableWithAxe targets, with a chop SFX and energy cost.

nodes.name: Binoculars
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject birding tool; enters the Birding player state and launches BirdingGame with configurable beam/charge/cursor tuning; costs energy.

nodes.name: Bow
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject bow weapon with charged shots: delegates to BowChargeController when a projectile spawn center exists, else fires immediately; exposes charge/min-speed/crit settings and energy cost.

nodes.name: DryLog
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject dry-log placement item for loading into LarchStumps or WoodRacks.

nodes.name: Firewood
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject fuel item added to WoodStoves and Campfires.

nodes.name: FlyAgaric2
nodes.summary: Edible fly-agaric mushroom ScriptableObject (variant 2); eats for protein/carbs/nutrients.

nodes.name: FlyAgaric
nodes.summary: Edible fly-agaric mushroom ScriptableObject (base variant); eats for protein/carbs/nutrients.

nodes.name: Hammer
nodes.summary: Marker ScriptableObject hammer item with no behavior of its own.

nodes.name: LooseItem
nodes.summary: World-space dropped item with an Inventory.ItemStack that becomes magnetic to the player once its drop animation reaches Idle.

nodes.name: RainbowTrout
nodes.summary: Rainbow trout ScriptableObject usable as a gift to IGiftReceiving NPCs or eaten for nutrition.

nodes.name: Rod
nodes.summary: Fishing rod ScriptableObject that casts on Water tilemaps and reels in when already fishing, toggling player state and driving FishingGame.

nodes.name: Sling
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject sling weapon that fires instantly via TryFire with an energy cost.

nodes.name: SpawnLooseItemsOnDisable
nodes.summary: Spawns configured loose items from a collider on OnDisable unless the scene is unloading, launching them with velocity/drag.

nodes.name: WetLog
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject wet-log item: refused by fire sources with a dialogue message but accepted by WoodRack for drying.

nodes.name: SetActiveWeapon
nodes.summary: Assigns the equipped weapon and its instance data to the Reloader's Reactive properties, which ReloadBar and friends subscribe to.

nodes.name: FixedUpdate
nodes.summary: Every fixed tick, advances reload and cooldown timers on the active weapon's instance data when their flags are set.

nodes.name: UpdateReloading
nodes.summary: Increments ReloadElapsed; when it reaches the weapon's reload time, resets it and refills the clip to full, clearing IsReloading.

nodes.name: UpdateCooldown
nodes.summary: Increments CoolDownElapsed; clears IsCoolingDown once it exceeds the fire-rate-derived cooldown time.

nodes.name: Seek
nodes.summary: Steering force steering toward a target position, clamped to a force limit from the difference between desired and current velocity.

nodes.name: CalculateWanderForce
nodes.summary: Projects a wander ring ahead of the entity, picks a random point on it (returned via ref/out), and Seeks it for wandering motion.

nodes.name: CalculateAvoidanceForce
nodes.summary: CircleCasts ahead along the velocity; on a non-trigger obstacle, pushes away proportionally to proximity, weighting by an avoidance factor and exposing the obstacle point.

nodes.name: CalculateBoidForce
nodes.summary: Computes a Reynolds-style boid force over the nearest IFlockMate neighbors (bounded by maxMates): weighted separation, alignment, and cohesion combined into a single normalized force.

nodes.name: GetInteractionLayers
nodes.summary: Builds a LayerMask from the global layer-collision matrix minus the object's own layer, then applies the rigidbody's excludeLayers/includeLayers overrides.

nodes.name: Play
nodes.summary: Boots the minigame: activates all UI pieces, caches player/cursor colliders and the cursor rigidbody, initializes a new game and first round, and starts the round coroutine.

nodes.name: CastForFish
nodes.summary: Starts a coroutine that waits a random bite-time range before Play() is called; called by the Rod item.

nodes.name: ReelInLine
nodes.summary: Stops the waiting-for-bite coroutine so the player can cancel a cast before the minigame starts.

nodes.name: UpdateGameCursor
nodes.summary: Interpolates the cursor and stretching bar-fill between start and end height by a 0-1 progress value, freezing the cursor if the round already failed.

nodes.name: PassedFishBarTrigger
nodes.summary: Message received from FishBarTrigger via SendMessageUpwards: marks the game failed if an unfulfilled trigger was passed.

nodes.name: InitializeNewGame
nodes.summary: Resets game-wide state: starts the reeling-in loop SFX, locks the player into Catching, picks a random valid fish, snapshots season/period, and resets failure flag and round counter.

nodes.name: InitializeNewRound
nodes.summary: Clears and rebuilds the trigger bars for a round from generated normalized positions, optionally arming oscillation.

nodes.name: PlayRound
nodes.summary: Core timing loop: advances the cursor over the round duration, breaks early on failure, then either fails the game, wins (last round), or recursively launches the next round.

nodes.name: OnUseItem
nodes.summary: The keypress handler: while fishing/catching, overlaps the cursor against triggers and fulfills the lowest unfulfilled one; no hit means an instant miss.

nodes.name: HandleGameWin
nodes.summary: On success: celebrates, plays the caught SFX, adds the fish item to inventory (or drops), logs the capture, stops the reel SFX, and hides the minigame UI.

nodes.name: HandleGameFail
nodes.summary: On failure: shakes the bar via DOTween and runs the red/grey blink + cursor-launch failure coroutine.

nodes.name: GenerateNormalizedTriggerPositions
nodes.summary: Procedurally places 0-1 normalized trigger positions per round modifier: singles with minimum spacing, pairs (doubles), or a stacked mega-cluster; always reserves 1.0 for the final trigger, then sorts.

nodes.name: InstantiateTriggers
nodes.summary: Spawns FishBarTrigger prefabs under the triggers container, mapping normalized positions to world bar space via the TRIGGER_MAPPING linear formula.

nodes.name: GetRandomValidFishType
nodes.summary: Filters child FishType components by current scene, season, and day period, logs diagnostics, and picks one at random.

nodes.name: OnDisable
nodes.summary: Spawns the configured loose items from the collider with launch velocity/drag, but only if the game object's scene is still loaded (skips scene-exit destruction).
